_comment: Tier-2 for chemistry:2, and the fixture that FALSIFIED half of it. The entry said a fraction sum below 1 has its remainder 'distributed over the species you left unset', and gave as its example a 0.1/0.1 deck in which nothing is unset. Executed: 'mixture gas N2 frac 0.1' + 'mixture gas O2 frac 0.1' realises 0.091/0.909 at step 0 — the LAST species absorbed the whole deficit despite its explicit 0.1. With a third species left unset the entry's stated rule does hold: 0.091/0.114/0.795. mixture.cpp:278 init_fraction() explains both, and it is two rules, not one: unset species share (1-sum)/nimplicit, AND the cumulative array's last entry is clamped to 1.0, so the last-listed species takes whatever is still missing. The entry has been corrected to state both. The over-1 case gives 'ERROR: Mixture gas fractions exceed 1.0 (../mixture.cpp:225)' verbatim; the under-1 case gives no ERROR and no WARNING. Compositions are asserted as PROPORTIONS within 0.05, never as counts, because which particle gets which species is drawn from the RNG. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 gives every deck fractions that sum to exactly 1.0, with the DECLARED tuple travelling with the deck as this fixture's design requires — the 0.1/0.1 deck becomes 0.8/0.2, the deck with an unset NO declares 'mixture gas NO frac 0.8', and the over-one 0.9/0.6 deck becomes 0.9/0.1. There is then no deficit for anything to absorb and nothing exceeds 1.0: the both-set deck realises 0.802/0.198/0.0 instead of 0.091/0.909/0.0, its last-species realised-over-declared ratio falls from 9.09 to 0.991, and the over-one deck exits 0 with no ERROR line. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: quoted_exceed_one_message_is_verbatim=True, with_every_fraction_set_the_last_species_absorbs_the_deficit=True, with_an_unset_species_present_the_unset_one_absorbs_it=True. Two things the control exposed. (1) under_one_is_accepted_with_no_error_and_no_warning stays True under mutation, but only vacuously — the mutated deck no longer sums to under one, so that string cannot by itself detect the loss of the pathology. (2) For the unset-species case the REALISED composition does not move at all, staying 0.091/0.114/0.795, because '0.1/0.1 with NO left unset' and '0.1/0.1/0.8' are the same composition; the assertion goes False purely because the declared deficit goes 0.8 -> 0.0. That is the correct discrimination for a claim about declared-versus-realised, and it is also the reason this claim can only ever be bookkeeping: SPARTA's output alone cannot tell the two decks apart. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/mixture_fraction_deficit_absorbed_silently && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
